identity_definitions.task_name: Full official task name, including SCENE prefix when present
identity_definitions.full_bddl_identity: Parsed complete BDDL ignoring problem name and language; lowercases atoms and sorts top-level fields, conjunctions, init lists, regions and object-of-interest lists; preserves scene geometry, init constraints, object identities and all goals
identity_definitions.benchmark_instruction: Exact official filename-derived instruction after removing scene prefix
identity_definitions.goal_operation_identity: Coarser sensitivity grouping: typed goal-argument graph, region roles, state-preservation flags and explicit state actions; canonical identical-type entity renaming; ignores scene geometry, initial position, distractors and which same-type instance was named

interpretation: There are 130 distinct official task instances by name and full BDDL identity; this is not proof of statistical independence or 130 distinct operation meanings.
The coarse goal-operation grouping is a sensitivity analysis, not a replacement for the frozen taxonomy or an assertion that grouped tasks are identical environments.
Task-instance counts reach 10 for state-only, state-plus-placement and single placement; coarse operation-family counts reach 10 only for state-only and single placement.
Multiple placement remains below ten even at the official task-instance level.
Future category/cluster definitions and case selection must be frozen separately; current720/possible600 evaluation is unchanged.
